category_title: Students performing concealed open challenges through illicit physical actions and monitoring teacher vigilance
scenario_title: Concealed disruptions during routine homework checking
minimal_context: The teacher is checking a daily homework assignment on paragraph topics with the whole class while Helen sits near a peer named Wes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's go now to Part A. Topics of paragraphs. This is homework, so everybody is ready. In Part A we have six paragraphs. 'A five tastes of food' is in paragraph three. (Looking at the book)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Employs a quick flick check at the teacher, hops up from her chair and leans over the table, dragging Wes's book closer to her, then gets her cell phone from Wes and smiles.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: How about b... Our five senses? Lisa, Helen. (Walking toward the board while looking back down at the book)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Glancing at Wes, then to the teacher, then to her book) One. (Her cell phone rings, and she picks it up and laughs)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Very good. Thank you. Yes, paragraph one. Helen, you get the point. (Standing with back facing towards Helen, eyes looking at the book, making a chart on the board)

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Picks up an object from the table and throws it at Wes, still holding her cell phone, looking at it and laughing. Then picks up a bigger object from the table and throws it at Wes.)

task.content: Checking homework for 'Part A. Topics of paragraphs' where students match paragraph numbers to main ideas (e.g., 'a five tastes of food is in paragraph three', 'How about b... Our five senses')

context.environment: Classroom setting during transition to a daily homework checking activity
context.materials: Textbook, board, cell phone, paper ball, objects on table
context.social_setting: Whole class activity where two students are called out to compete for the answer; Helen is sitting near a male student named Wes

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When the teacher confirms her correct answer and praises her while his back is facing towards her and his eyes are looking at the book
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Picks up an object from the table and throws it at Wes, holds her cell phone, looks at it and laughs, then picks up a bigger object from the table and throws it at Wes
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Actively preparing for a 'concealed open challenge' and not interested in the competition

behavior_patterns.condition: When the teacher's verbal and bodily orientation are on the current task and looking at the book
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Employs a 'flick check' at the teacher, hops up from her chair and leans over the table, drags Wes' book closer to her, and gets her cell phone

behavior_patterns.condition: When called out for the competition to provide the answer
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Glancing at Wes, then to the teacher, then to her book, provides the answer, then picking up her cell phone and laughing when it rings
